name: Fleet Atlas
notes: Flight menu adds an Update button that unregisters the service worker, clears stale farbound caches, and reloads onto the latest Pages beta build.
A waiting worker or a newer release.mjs chip highlights the button as Update available. Offline play of the current build is left alone until you tap Update.
Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.15.6 so Pages picks up the helper and menu control.
